messages:
olivia: Heads up — we need a new GPU node pool in europe-west3 (uk-west) to serve a low-latency inference shard for eu customers. Quota is tight but latency for that tenant is <100ms target.
hao: What VM types are you thinking? H100s generally best but quotas + cost. Could do A10G for embedding-heavy traffic.
olivia: Thinking H100 for perf-sensitive prompts. Plan: a small dedicated pool (3-6 nodes) with a spot/MIG fallback pool for burst. Aim is predictable baseline + cheaper burst.
mateo: +1 on dedicated baseline. Also recommend taint:dedicated=infer:NoSchedule on baseline pool so batch jobs don’t land.
sree: Quick quota check — GCE reported only 8 H100 quota left in the region for project. @quota-team we’ll need quota bump or alternative.
quota-team: low-friction — opened ticket GCP-4392 to request +20 H100; ETA 36h. Please add exact SKUs and regions.
olivia: Thanks. Request details: region europe-west3, sku h100-v100? (use latest name). I'll paste machine type: n1-standard? Actually we want a2-highgpu? Let's attach exact: a2-highgpu-1g (A100) vs m2-ultramem? debating.
nikhil: For H100 the family is a3/m3? On GCP the H100 SKUs are "a3" types for 1xH100. If quotas take too long we can provision a10g (a2) pool first.
lisa: If we do mixed pools, keep separate labels: gpu.workload=infer (baseline) and gpu.workload=burst (spot). Helps nodeSelector in deployments.
olivia: Autoscaler config draft below — want to keep scale-down-delay high on baseline so we don’t thrash kernels:
```
apiVersion: autoscaling.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterAutoscaler
spec:
  scaleDown:
    delayAfterAdd: 30m
    delayAfterDelete: 10m
    delayAfterFailure: 15m
  balanceSimilarNodeGroups: true
  maxNodeProvisionTime: 15m
```
hao: Suggest adding multiple node groups with different taints and priorities to feed CA expander policy. Use expander: least-waste to prefer spot pool for short bursts.
mateo: Also enable nodeAffinity for topologySpread across 3 AZs to avoid AZ-level quota hits. Add labels: topology.kubernetes.io/zone.
sree: Networking note: new pool will allocate /24 secondary IP ranges. We are at 82% of usable Pod IPs in europe-west3-cluster-1. Need to request additional secondary ranges or CIDR expansion. Otherwise new nodes will fail to join.
olivia: Good catch. Can infra team check VPC secondary ranges and egress NAT IP availability? We saw ephemeral egress IP exhaustion causing pods to fail external model fetches last month.
infra-bot: [automation] created task INF-872: allocate additional secondary CIDR for cluster europe-west3-cluster-1.
nikhil: Cost model: H100 baseline ~3.8x A10G on list price. With reserved committed use (1yr) baseline cost down ~30%. Spot pool for burst reduces effective average. I'll prepare a per-token cost delta.
lisa: Ops checklist: nodeImage: cos-containerd-xx or ubuntu-ml image? If using kernel mods for MIG we need ubuntu-ml. Also set kubelet --eviction-hard for GPU memory pressure.
olivia: Final ask: approve two node groups: 3x H100 dedicated (taint=dedicated=infer) + 6x A10G spot (taint=spot=burst) and autoscaler policy as above. I'll link the quota ticket to this thread once GCP approves.
hao: I can do the Terraform module once quotas & CIDR are confirmed. Will include rollout plan: create spot pool first, label, test canary traffic, then create baseline and shift 20% traffic, observe.
mateo: Can we set PodPriority for critical inference jobs so CA won't evict them from spot? Need to avoid noisy-neighbor preemption.
sree: After quota confirmation, I'll run a dry-run provision in staging cluster to validate IP ranges and kubelet flags.
olivia: Perfect — thanks everyone. Will follow up with exact machine SKU and link to ticket. :thumbsup:
